USEFUL ANSWERS

Common questions.

Office & contact details
What services does PSB Associates provide?

P S B & Associates LLP provides audit and assurance, income tax and GST compliance, corporate advisory, business setup, accounting outsourcing, payroll, MIS reporting and virtual CFO services.

Does PSB Associates serve clients outside its office cities?

Yes. P S B & Associates LLP serves clients in India and abroad. Engagements are scoped around the client’s business, applicable requirements and professional obligations rather than a particular city.

Where are PSB Associates offices located?

The firm has offices in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Hingoli and Pune, Maharashtra. Office addresses and directions are available on the Contact page.

View more questionsView fewer questions
Does PSB work with startups and companies?

Yes. The firm supports startups, Indian and multinational companies, financial institutions, individuals, NGOs and public trusts. Engagement scope is agreed according to each client’s requirements.

Which industries does PSB Associates serve?

P S B & Associates LLP serves the following sectors: Software & Information Technology; Engineering; Travel & Hospitality; Education; Banking & Financial Services; NGOs & Public Trusts; Hospital & Healthcare; Maritime & Transportation; Builders & Developers. Services include accounting, taxation, audit and advisory, for businesses and organisations in India and abroad.

How can I contact PSB Associates?

Email office@psbassociates.in or call +91 99224 12220. Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM IST.

Where does the PSB Briefing get its updates?

The Briefing checks the official GST, Income Tax, ICAI and RBI announcement sources. Each item links to its official source and shows the publication date when available. Refresh checks all four sources immediately; unavailable sources retain clearly marked previously checked information.
